# OmniRust-template

> OmniRust-template: maximalist Omni family member. 

Part of the WyattAu Omni template family: maximalist, monorepo-first
scaffolds sharing one gate matrix (engineering-standards).

## Docs

- [README](https://github.com/WyattAu/OmniRust-template/blob/main/README.md): quick start + make targets
- [ARCHITECTURE](https://github.com/WyattAu/OmniRust-template/blob/main/ARCHITECTURE.md): why the repo is shaped this way
- [OMNI-CORE](https://github.com/WyattAu/engineering-standards/blob/main/OMNI-CORE.md): the family-wide contract
- [CONTRIBUTING](https://github.com/WyattAu/OmniRust-template/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md): workflow rules
- [AGENTS.md](https://github.com/WyattAu/OmniRust-template/blob/main/AGENTS.md): instructions for AI agents
- [Goals index](https://github.com/WyattAu/OmniRust-template/blob/main/docs/goals/index.md): vision corpus (1,250 breakthroughs / 126 pillars), keystones, ten-year phases
- [ADR-0009](https://github.com/WyattAu/OmniRust-template/blob/main/docs/adr/0009-ten-year-goals-phasing.md): ten-year phasing decision
- [engineering-standards](https://github.com/WyattAu/engineering-standards): the estate gate matrix
